citation.authors: Alsharif SA, Baradwan S, Alshahrani MS, Khadawardi K et al

record.population: 511 women with fibroids in 5 randomised trials of oral vitamin D (256 treated, 255 on placebo)
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised trials
record.finding: Vitamin D supplementation significantly decreased fibroid size (standardised mean difference -0.48, 95% CI -0.66 to -0.31) and raised serum vitamin D, with a larger effect in trials lasting more than 8 weeks. The authors say larger well-designed trials are needed for other outcomes.
record.note: Trials were not in Black women; I did not read which countries or whether low-certainty.
